description: Implementation of CustomerOptionSetDao for accessing CustomerOptionSet entities, including methods for retrieving by ID, option ID, option value ID, and listing by store with localization support.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOptionSet entity, providing methods to fetch option sets by various criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its unique identifier, performing joins to fetch related options and descriptions.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific option ID within a given merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Fetches a list of CustomerOptionSet entities associated with a specific option value ID within a given merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all CustomerOptionSet entities for a store, including descriptions filtered by language, ordered by sort order.
